modal_password_title: Hold on and PLEASE READ ON...
modal_password_shortdesc:
If the field is not empty, files would be encrypted locally before being uploaded.
If the field is empty, then files would be uploaded without encryption.
modal_password_attn1: Attention 1/5: The vault name is NOT encrypted. The plugin creates a folder with the vault name on some remote services.
modal_password_attn2: Attention 2/5: The password itself is stored in PLAIN TEXT LOCALLY.
modal_password_attn3: Attention 3/5: Some metadata are not encrypted or can be easily guessed. (File sizes are closed to their unencrypted ones, and directory path may be stored as 0-byte-size object.)
modal_password_attn4: Attention 4/5: You should make sure the remote store IS EMPTY, or REMOTE FILES WERE ENCRYPTED BY THAT NEW PASSWORD, to avoid conflicts.
modal_password_attn5: Attention 5/5: The longer the password, the better.
modal_password_secondconfirm: The Second Confirm to change password.
modal_encryptionmethod_title: Hold on and PLEASE READ ON...
modal_encryptionmethod_shortdesc: You are changing the encryption method but you have set the password before. After switching the method, you need to manually and fully delete every encrypted vault files in the remote and re-sync (so that re-upload) the newly encrypted files again.
modal_remotebasedir_title: You are changing the remote base directory config
modal_remotebasedir_shortdesc:
1. The plugin would NOT automatically move the content from the old directory to the new one directly on the remote. Everything syncs from the beginning again.
2. If you set the string to the empty, the config would be reset to use the vault folder name (the default config).
3. The remote directory name itself would not be encrypted even you've set an E2E password.
4. Some special char like '?', '/', '\' are not allowed. Spaces in the beginning or in the end are also trimmed.
modal_remotebasedir_invaliddirhint: Your input contains special characters like '?', '/', '\' which are not allowed.
modal_remotebasedir_secondconfirm_vaultn: Reset To The Default Vault Folder Name
modal_remotebasedir_notice: New remote base directory config saved!

modal_dropboxauth_autosteps:
Visit the address in a browser, and follow the steps.
Finally you should be redirected to Obsidian.

modal_onedriveauth_copybutton: Click to copy the auth url

modal_onedriverevokeauth_step2: Step 2: Click the button below, to clean the locally-saved login credentials.
modal_onedriverevokeauth_clean_desc: You need to click the button.
modal_syncconfig_attn:
Attention 1/2: This only syncs (copies) the whole Obsidian config dir, not other starting-with-dot folders or files. Except for ignoring folders .git and node_modules, it also doesn't understand the meaning of sub-files and sub-folders inside the config dir.
Attention 2/2: After the config dir is synced, plugins settings might be corrupted, and Obsidian might need to be restarted to load the new settings.
If you are agreed to take your own risk, please click the following second confirm button.
modal_qr_shortdesc:
This exports your settings.
You can use another device to scan this QR code.
Or, click the button to copy the URI and paste it into another device's browser or the plugin's import screen.
modal_qr_shortdesc_partial:
This exports your settings. Note: Dropbox/OneDrive auth tokens are excluded and will need to be reconnected on the other device.
You can use another device to scan this QR code.
Or, click the button to copy the URI and paste it into another device's browser or the plugin's import screen.

modal_sizesconflict_title: Remotely Save: Some conflict were found while skipping large files
modal_sizesconflict_desc:
You've set skipping files larger than {{thresholdMB}} MB ({{thresholdBytes}} bytes).
But the following files have sizes larger than the threshold on one side, and sizes smaller than the threshold on the other side.
To avoid unexpected overwriting or deleting, the plugin stops, and you have to manually deal with at least one side of the files.
modal_sizesconflict_copybutton: Click to copy all the below sizes conflicts info
modal_sizesconflict_copynotice: All the sizes conflicts info have been copied to the clipboard!
settings_password_desc: Leave empty to disable encryption. Click Confirm to apply. Changing the password requires deleting all remote files and re-syncing.
settings_check_connectivity_desc: Tests that the remote is reachable. If a password is set, also verifies it matches the remote.
settings_check_enc_empty_remote: Connected. Remote is empty — password will be used on first sync.
settings_check_enc_wrong_pw: Password or encryption method does not match the remote.
settings_check_enc_wrong_method: Encryption method does not match the remote.
settings_check_enc_remote_has_pw_local_n: Remote appears encrypted but no password is set.
settings_autorun_desc: The plugin tries to schedule the running after every interval. Battery may be impacted.
settings_runoncestartup_desc: This setting causes the sync to run once automatically at startup. Changes will take effect on the NEXT startup.
settings_runoncestartup_1sec: sync once after 1 second of start up
settings_runoncestartup_10sec: sync once after 10 seconds of start up
settings_runoncestartup_30sec: sync once after 30 seconds of start up
settings_synconsave_desc: If you change your file, the plugin tries to trigger a sync.
settings_saverun_desc: Trigger a sync after this delay following a file save.
settings_remoterun_desc: Trigger a sync when a remote change is detected.
settings_skiplargefiles_desc: Skip files with sizes larger than the threshold. Here 1 MB = 10^6 bytes.
settings_ignorepaths_desc: One entry per line. Plain paths are matched as prefixes (e.g. .trash). Regex is also supported (e.g. ^_.*).
settings_onlyallowpaths_desc: Regex of paths of folders or files to allow to sync. One regex per line.
settings_enablestatusbar_info: Show Last Sync in Status Bar
settings_enablestatusbar_info_desc: Show the time of the last successful sync in the status bar.
settings_enablestatusbar_reloadrequired_: Reload the plugin for the changes to take effect.
settings_showlastsyncedonly_desc: Only show the last synced file in the status bar.
settings_remotebasedir_desc: By default the content is synced to a remote directory with the same name as the vault name. You can change the remote folder name here, or keep the input field empty to reset to the default. You need to click "Confirm".
settings_s3_disclaimer1: Disclaimer: This plugin is NOT an official Amazon product.
settings_s3_disclaimer2: Disclaimer: The information is stored locally. Other malicious/harmful/faulty plugins could read the info. If you see any unintentional access to your bucket, please immediately delete the access key on your AWS (or other S3-service provider) settings.
settings_s3_cors: You need to configure CORS to allow requests from origin app://obsidian.md and capacitor://localhost and http://localhost, and add ETag into exposed headers.
settings_s3_prod: Some Amazon S3 official docs for references:
settings_s3_prod2: Access Key ID and Secret Access Key info
settings_s3_accesskeyid_desc: Access key ID. Attention: Access key ID and other info are saved locally.
settings_s3_secretaccesskey_desc: Secret access key. Attention: Secret access key and other info are saved locally.
settings_s3_bypasscorslocally_desc: Skip server-side CORS config on modern Obsidian. Disable if you have connection issues.
settings_s3_parts_desc: Max parallel upload parts for large files.
settings_s3_urlstyle_desc: Path-style: s3.host/bucket/ (default for most compatible services). Subdomain-style: bucket.s3.host/.
settings_s3_connect_succ: Great! The bucket can be accessed.
settings_s3_connect_fail: The S3 bucket cannot be reached.
settings_dropbox_disclaimer1: Disclaimer: This app is NOT an official Dropbox product.
settings_dropbox_disclaimer2: Disclaimer: The information is stored locally. Other malicious/harmful/faulty plugins could read the info. If you see any unintentional access to your Dropbox, please immediately disconnect this app on https://www.dropbox.com/account/connected_apps .
settings_dropbox_folder: We will create and sync inside the folder /Apps/{{pluginID}}/{{remoteBaseDir}} on your Dropbox.
settings_dropbox_revoke_desc: You've connected as user {{username}}. If you want to disconnect, click this button.
settings_dropbox_clearlocal_desc: You can forcefully clear the locally saved Dropbox login credentials, but not send revoke auth request to the server.
settings_dropbox_connect_succ: Great! We can connect to Dropbox!
settings_onedrive_disclaimer1: Disclaimer: This app is NOT an official Microsoft / OneDrive product.
settings_onedrive_disclaimer2: Disclaimer: The information is stored locally. Other malicious/harmful/faulty plugins could read the info. If you see any unintentional access to your Onedrive, please immediately disconnect this app on https://microsoft.com/consent .
settings_onedrive_folder: We will create and sync inside the folder /Apps/{{pluginID}}/{{remoteBaseDir}} on your OneDrive.
settings_onedrive_nobiz: Currently only OneDrive for personal is supported. OneDrive for Business is NOT supported (yet).
settings_onedrive_revoke_desc: You've connected as user {{username}}. If you want to disconnect, click this button.
settings_onedrive_connect_succ: Great! We can connect to OneDrive!
settings_webdav_disclaimer1: Disclaimer: The information is stored locally. Other malicious/harmful/faulty plugins may read the info. If you see any unintentional access to your webdav server, please immediately change the username and password.
settings_webdav_cors_os: Obsidian desktop>=0.13.25 or iOS>=1.1.1 or Android>=1.2.1 supports bypassing CORS locally. But you are using an old version, and you're suggested to upgrade Obsidian.
settings_webdav_cors: You need to configure CORS to allow requests from origin app://obsidian.md and capacitor://localhost and http://localhost
settings_webdav_folder: We will create and sync inside the folder /{{remoteBaseDir}} on your server.
settings_webdav_user_desc: Username. Attention: the username and other info are saved locally.
settings_webdav_password_desc: Password. Attention: the password and other info are saved locally.
settings_webdav_auth_desc: If no password is provided, this option will be ignored.
settings_webdav_depth_desc: Webdav servers should be configured to allow requests with header Depth being '1' or 'Infinity'.
settings_webdav_connect_succ: Great! The webdav server can be accessed.
settings_webdav_connect_fail: The webdav server cannot be reached (possible to be any of address/username/password/authtype errors).
settings_webdav_connect_fail_withcors: The webdav server cannot be reached (possible to be any of address/username/password/authtype/CORS errors).
settings_protondrive_disclaimer1: Disclaimer: This plugin is NOT an official Proton product.
settings_protondrive_disclaimer2: Disclaimer: Your Proton password is never stored. Only session tokens are saved locally.
settings_protondrive_password_desc: Your Proton account password. This is never stored.
settings_protondrive_totp_desc: Your TOTP code if 2-factor authentication is enabled.
settings_protondrive_remote_base_dir_des: Folder name on Proton Drive. Defaults to vault name.
settings_protondrive_connect_succ: Great! We can connect to Proton Drive!
settings_chooseservice_desc: Start here. What service are you connecting to?
settings_concurrency_desc: Max files uploaded or downloaded at once. Lower if you hit rate limits.
settings_syncunderscore_desc: Sync files or folders starting with _ ("underscore") or not
settings_configdir_desc: Sync config dir {{configDir}} or not (inner folder .git and node_modules would be ignored). Please be aware that this may impact all your plugins' or Obsidian's settings, and may require you restart Obsidian after sync. Enable this at your own risk.
settings_conflictaction_desc: What to do when a file is modified on both sides since the last sync. Only applies to bidirectional sync.
settings_conflictaction_smart_conflict_d: Note: smart conflict requires the file to be a markdown file. Otherwise it falls back to keep_newer.
settings_cleanemptyfolder_desc: What to do with folders that contain no files.
settings_protectmodifypercentage_desc: Cancel the sync if more than this % of files would be modified or deleted. Protects against accidental mass changes. Set to 100 to disable.
setting_syncdirection_desc:
Only changed files (by time and size) are synced regardless of mode.

  1. Bidirectional: Changes on both sides are merged.
  2. Push only: Local changes are copied to remote. Remote-only changes are ignored.
  3. Pull only: Remote changes are copied to local. Local-only changes are ignored.
  4. Push + delete: Like push, but local deletions are also applied to remote.
  5. Pull + delete: Like pull, but remote deletions are also applied to local.
settings_trash_locally: Move Deleted Files To Trash Locally
settings_trash_locally_desc: Move locally deleted files to the system trash instead of permanently deleting.
settings_importexport_desc: Export settings to a JSON file or import from one. Supports optional password encryption.
settings_export_desc: Export settings to a JSON file. Optionally encrypt with a password.
settings_import_desc: Import settings from a previously exported JSON file.
modal_export_oauth_warning: Note: Dropbox and OneDrive auth tokens will not be exported. You will need to reconnect those services on the other device.
modal_export_password_desc: Leave the password blank to export as plain JSON.
modal_import_desc: Select a settings JSON file to import. Enter the password if it was encrypted.
modal_import_success: Settings imported. Reload the plugin for all changes to take effect.
settings_debuglevel_desc: Switch to debug for verbose sync output.
settings_outputsettingsconsole_desc: Prints current settings, vault path, and vault ID to the developer console.
settings_syncplans_desc: Export a record of what the plugin decided to sync before each run.
settings_delsyncplans_desc: Removes stored sync plan history from the local database.
settings_logtodb_desc: Save log output to local database.
settings_logtodbexport_desc: Export logs saved in the local database to files in the vault.
settings_logtodbclear_desc: Remove all log records saved in the local database.
settings_outputbasepathvaultid_desc: Displays the vault base path and its randomly assigned internal ID.
settings_resetcache_desc: Wipes the local sync database without affecting your remote files or settings.
settings_resetcache_notice: Local database wiped. Please reload the plugin.
settings_reset_sync_metadata_desc: Delete and reset the remote sync metadata file.
